source_question: 44% of Guatemala HFC Networks have FTTH overlapped ODN
core: 44% of Guatemala's HFC network has been overlaid with FTTH ODN.
meaning_cn: 危地马拉 44% 的 HFC 网络已经叠加了 FTTH ODN。
explanation_cn: 描述在既有 HFC 网络上叠加光纤网络时，常用 be overlaid with。network 作为整体是单数，因此用 has been。FTTH ODN 作被叠加的网络基础设施；原句 have FTTH overlapped ODN 的主谓一致和搭配都不自然。
source_sentence: 44% of Guatemala HFC Networks have FTTH overlapped ODN

examples.en: 44% of Guatemala's HFC network has been overlaid with FTTH ODN.
examples.cn: 危地马拉 44% 的 HFC 网络已经叠加了 FTTH ODN。

examples.en: The operator is overlaying FTTH in high-value HFC areas.
examples.cn: 该运营商正在高价值 HFC 区域叠加建设 FTTH。

examples.en: Fiber overlay allows the operator to offer higher and more symmetric speeds.
examples.cn: 光纤叠加使运营商能够提供更高且更对称的速率。

pronunciation.text: 44% of Guatemala's HFC network has been overlaid with FTTH ODN.
pronunciation.hint_cn: HFC、FTTH 和 ODN 逐字母读；重读 44%、overlaid 和 FTTH ODN。

source_question: Guatemala department concentrates 86% of the nodes to be migrated, coinciding with the most valuable areas in Guatemala.
core: Guatemala Department accounts for 86% of the nodes targeted for migration, most of which are located in the country's highest-value areas.
meaning_cn: 危地马拉省占计划迁转节点的 86%，其中大部分位于全国最高价值区域。
explanation_cn: 地区作为占比主体时，使用 account for 比 concentrates 更自然。nodes targeted for migration 比 nodes to be migrated 更紧凑，适合 PPT。most of which 引导非限制性定语从句，补充说明这些节点的空间分布；highest-value 作复合形容词需要连字符。
source_sentence: Guatemala department concentrates 86% of the nodes to be migrated, coinciding with the most valuable areas in Guatemala.

examples.en: Guatemala Department accounts for 86% of the nodes targeted for migration, most of which are located in the country's highest-value areas.
examples.cn: 危地马拉省占计划迁转节点的 86%，其中大部分位于全国最高价值区域。

examples.en: The capital region accounts for most of the nodes selected for the first migration phase.
examples.cn: 首都区域占第一阶段所选迁转节点的大部分。

examples.en: Most of these sites are located in high-density, high-value areas.
examples.cn: 这些站点大多位于高密度、高价值区域。

pronunciation.text: Guatemala Department accounts for 86% of the nodes targeted for migration, most of which are located in the country's highest-value areas.
pronunciation.hint_cn: 重读 Guatemala Department、86%、targeted for migration 和 highest-value areas；accounts for 连读。

source_question: FBB Scale Creates the Base; FMC Conversion Delivers MBB Growth
core: FBB scale creates the foundation; FMC conversion drives MBB growth.
meaning_cn: FBB 规模构成基础，FMC 转化驱动 MBB 增长。
explanation_cn: 在战略型标题中，creates the foundation 比 creates the base 更自然，强调 FBB 规模是后续融合经营的基础。FMC conversion 表示把既有用户基础转化为融合用户；drives 比 delivers 更适合表达持续的增长驱动。分号连接两个结构平行、逻辑递进的分句。
source_sentence: FBB Scale Creates the Base; FMC Conversion Delivers MBB Growth

examples.en: FBB scale creates the foundation; FMC conversion drives MBB growth.
examples.cn: FBB 规模构成基础，FMC 转化驱动 MBB 增长。

examples.en: A larger FBB base creates more opportunities for FMC conversion.
examples.cn: 更大的 FBB 用户基础能够创造更多 FMC 转化机会。

examples.en: Coverage alone is not enough; subscriber conversion turns network scale into mobile growth.
examples.cn: 仅有覆盖还不够；用户转化才能把网络规模转化为移动业务增长。

pronunciation.text: FBB scale creates the foundation; FMC conversion drives MBB growth.
pronunciation.hint_cn: FBB、FMC 和 MBB 逐字母读；重读 scale、foundation、conversion 和 drives。

source_question: 建议在最高价值的区域优先叠光，弥补HFC对高体验人群的满足度差距
core: Prioritize FTTH overlay in the highest-value areas to close HFC experience gaps for premium users.
meaning_cn: 优先在最高价值区域叠加建设 FTTH，弥补 HFC 对高端用户的体验差距。
explanation_cn: prioritize FTTH overlay 是简洁的行动型 PPT 表达；highest-value 作复合形容词需要连字符。close an experience gap 表示缩小或弥补体验差距。premium users 用于概括对速率、对称性和稳定性要求更高的高价值用户。
source_sentence: 建议在最高价值的区域优先叠光，弥补HFC对高体验人群的满足度差距

examples.en: Prioritize FTTH overlay in the highest-value areas to close HFC experience gaps for premium users.
examples.cn: 优先在最高价值区域叠加建设 FTTH，弥补 HFC 对高端用户的体验差距。

examples.en: FTTH overlay enables symmetric gigabit offers for users with higher experience expectations.
examples.cn: FTTH 叠加建设能够为体验要求更高的用户提供千兆对称套餐。

examples.en: The first rollout should focus on areas where HFC can no longer meet premium experience needs.
examples.cn: 第一阶段建设应聚焦 HFC 已难以满足高端体验需求的区域。

pronunciation.text: Prioritize FTTH overlay in the highest-value areas to close HFC experience gaps for premium users.
pronunciation.hint_cn: FTTH 和 HFC 逐字母读；重读 prioritize、overlay、highest-value、experience gaps 和 premium users。
